summary: Frontend-only mobile retest completed on the public Expo preview. In a fresh context, an expense was created, edited from $24.50 Food to $31.75 Transportation, and then deleted; the updated row/amount appeared and the deleted row remained absent after reload.
critical_code_review_comments: Edit and delete testIDs are present and local persistence is awaited. Native Alert confirmation is not represented as a stable testID, which made automated confirmation targeting unreliable, but deletion itself and persisted empty state were verified.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted one local test expense during browser testing; no remaining test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fresh mobile viewport 375x667 used against https://expense-tracker-6729.preview.emergentagent.com. No mocked APIs; app uses local storage only.
rca_of_issue: Iteration 3 uncertainty was test-state related. In a fresh context, stable generated edit-{id} and delete-{id} selectors were discovered and edit passed. Delete invoked the React Native Alert and the row disappeared; a subsequent fresh load showed the empty state, confirming persistence.
